review_locator: PMCID:PMC3579502, Transcriptional regulation of follicular T-helper (Tfh) cells; PMCID:PMC4174316, Complex Interactions of Transcription Factors in Mediating Cytokine Biology in T Cells
primary_title: The AP-1 transcription factor Batf controls T(H)17 differentiation
decision_basis: The review identifies BATF binding at the IL-21 promoter in Th17 cells; the cited primary reports BATF binding at the Il21 promoter, reduced Il21 expression in Batf-deficient Th17 cells and corresponding IL-21 protein loss, supporting a bounded BATF-to-IL21 gene-regulation edge.
limitations_preserved: Direct promoter occupancy plus Batf-dependent Il21 transcript/protein readouts support gene activation; transcript regulation does not by itself establish secretion dynamics, IL21R signaling, SCI relevance, or terminal-TF output.
